text:
emma: RFC follow-up: proposing a 'stitch plan' for gradual service peel. Instead of a big extract, we insert a tiny stitching adapter that can forward, mirror, normalize, or accept traffic per-tenant. Goals: reduce blast radius, enable tenant-by-tenant cutover, and keep rollback cheap.

raj: quick Q  what's expected latency hit on hot path?

emma: estimate 0.8-2ms median; worst-case ~5ms under auth misses. We'll validate in spike.

tiffany: parity detection? hashes noisy for streaming responses.

emma: two-stage detection: sampled response-hash for signal, semantic checks (intent/slot parity) for flagged samples, nightly deterministic regression. Auto-pause if semantic-diff exceeds threshold.

raj: cache/key-shape mismatch is risky. stitch must normalize keys and emulate old eviction semantics until prune.

emma: yes. adapter provides key translate + compatibility mode behind feature-flag. ops can toggle strictness per-tenant.

ops-bot: Created TKT-1201: "feature-proxy: per-tenant stitch flags + invalidation hooks". Assignee: infra. ETA: 72h.

tiffany: rollout guard suggestion: per-tenant token-bucket ramp. start 0.5% for big tenants, linear steps early. avoid geometric doubles.

emma: updating rollout: start_fraction 0.005, linear_step 0.005 every 30m to 5%, then small geometric ramps. Monitors: semantic-diff, latency-p95, error-rate. Auto-pause on semantic-diff>0.2%, rollback on error>1%.

raj: add X-Migration-Id header and migration.owner tag for trace filtering. also include a "dry-run" mirror mode.

emma: will add X-Migration-Id and X-Migration-Owner headers and dry-run. Adding dash tiles in addendum: percent routed, per-tenant ramp, diff-heatmap, prune-candidates.

tiffany: lifecycle: when do we prune adapters?

emma: policy: after 14 days with <0.1% semantic diffs and >95% traffic on new path, mark tenant for prune; ops schedules prune window and prunes are reversible for 48h.

raj: tests: KV skew, auth miss storms, load surge with mixed prompt lengths, streaming cutovers, and rollback under 10% and 50% traffic.

emma: adding test matrix and rollback playbook to spike doc. I'll post RFC addendum EOD. Thanks for feedback.
